supersedes.note: REV2 applies D1-D3 from REV1_ACCEPTED_WITH_REVIEWER_FACTUAL_ADDENDUM; earlier R1-R5/N1-N2 remain in force.

target.ccf_rank: C (third-party sources; official CCF catalogue not re-verified)
target.fit: software quality, software testing, measurement, case studies

claims.statement: 本研究的贡献是一套分阶段运行前承诺的单键扰动操作化协议：单位 = 项目 × 条件，筛查每项目 8 个键；恢复块只对选定合格单位执行 A1→B→A2，两块分别调度（不主张统计独立），E0—E4 等级把观察、基线、身份/阶段/签名、恢复与读取链分开；不主张 A1→B→A2 设计优先权，也不声称全阶段一次性预注册。
claims.denominator: 240 个筛查单位；恢复块只对选定合格单位执行，不是每个筛查单位都做恢复
must_not_contain: 每个筛查单位都做恢复
claims.allowed_wording: We operationalize a protocol that combines single-key perturbation, committed A1-B-A2 recovery blocks and an evidence ladder; we do not claim priority for the design.
claims.forbidden_wording: We invented A1-B-A2; all stages were pre-registered at once; the protocol is proven novel.

claims.statement: S1b 在三个项目确认五个 E2 单位；S2 仅对这五个选定单位执行两块恢复后，twine/K06_TERM 与 rich-toolkit/K07_COLUMNS 登记 E4，typer 三单位因注册基线未复现而维持 E2、恢复不可评价。两个 E4 是单位，不是两个独立机制。

evidence.role: S2 登记附件与等级分布

claims.denominator: 5 个 S1b 单位 × 2 块 × 3 阶段 = 30 个 S2 会话
claims.allowed_wording: Two S2 units reached E4 and three remained E2 because recovery was not evaluable; units are not independent mechanisms.
claims.forbidden_wording: All five signals were recovered; the two E4 units are two independent mechanisms.

claims.statement: 五个 S1b 单位的注册翻转集在 S2 全部 10 个块中复现（152/2/2/3/1 个节点）；该事实不替代 C0/C5 与恢复资格，也不把 typer 三单位变成阴性。
claims.denominator: 10 个 S2 块（5 单位 × 2 块）
claims.allowed_wording: Flip sets were reproduced in all ten blocks even where baseline reproduction failed; this does not substitute the other gates.
claims.forbidden_wording: Reproducing the flip sets upgrades all units or proves recovery.

claims.statement: 五个 S1b 单位共享 rich 15.0.0 读取层，三条路径分别为 COLUMNS → Console 宽度、NO_COLOR → no_color、TERM=dumb → color_system=None；已关闭的 rich-argparse/K07_COLUMNS 读取层是 stdlib optparse；S2 新签读取链只覆盖 twine 与 rich-toolkit，不扩展为全部八个单位。

evidence.role: S1b 项目与工具链分层

claims.denominator: 5 个 S1b 单位；rich 15.0.0 的 4 个读取位置
requires: 不扩展为全部八个单位
claims.allowed_wording: The five supplementary units share a rich 15.0.0 read layer along three paths; the earlier rich-argparse COLUMNS unit reads through stdlib optparse.
claims.forbidden_wording: All eight units read the keys through rich; the number of units equals the number of mechanisms.

claims.statement: 本研究未确认功能缺陷；不能把未确认缺陷反推为已证明全部差异都是纯表示变化；逐案表示层标签只覆盖该案已检查的断言，不外推到整产品契约或功能行为。

evidence.role: 表示层与契约措辞边界

claims.denominator: 五个 S1b 单位及探索/验证的已登记单位
must_not_contain: 整产品契约符合性已证明
claims.allowed_wording: Observed differences fall in the examined rendered-output assertions; no functional defect or whole-product contract compliance is certified.
claims.forbidden_wording: The study found functional bugs; every observed difference is proven to be pure representation.

claims.statement: 30 个项目名 = 主队列 25（探索 18 + 验证 7）+ 补充 S1b 5；主队列为下载量配额抽样，已知工件身份选择偏差按 10 / 4 / 11 口径披露：10 个未入选候选有 A6 错误源码收集记录，4 项停在依赖解析阶段，加 1 个入选项目共 11 项受限重验；补充层工具链不同；各阶段规则分别冻结，不是全部一次性预注册。

evidence.role: 冻结栈淘汰与选择偏差

claims.denominator: 30 个项目名；25 个主队列 + 5 个补充
claims.allowed_wording: In this download-rank quota sample with disclosed selection biases, eight project-condition units were registered; no prevalence estimate is made.
claims.forbidden_wording: The sample is a probability sample of the Python ecosystem; all 30 projects came from one unbiased uniform quota.

claims.statement: 登记研究调用 3,086 = 3,014 套件会话 + 72 见证；覆盖合计 3,455 = 3,086 + 59 + 310；3,056 / 2,984 / 3,425 仅为 S2 前快照。它们是工作量计数，不是样本量、进程总数或项目总成本。

evidence.role: S2 的 30 个注册会话

claims.denominator: 登记调用（分 S2 前 / S2 后）
claims.allowed_wording: We report 3,086 registered research calls after S2 as a workload count; 3,056 is the pre-S2 snapshot.
claims.forbidden_wording: The study analysed 3,086 independent samples; 3,455 processes were executed.

claims.statement: S3 原批 108 格中 9 个 RETAINED；纠错批 12 格中 3 个盲区标签指向同一个 S0 盲区；独立原套件盲区 1 个；已签降级 0 个，零不证明不存在降级。新旧分母分报，不合并。

evidence.role: S3 判定分布与盲区计数

claims.denominator: 108 个原批修复格与 12 个纠错格，分报
claims.allowed_wording: Nine retained readings, one independent original-suite blind spot and zero signed degradations were registered; zero does not prove absence.
claims.forbidden_wording: There is no degradation anywhere; the suites detect all relevant mutants.

claims.statement: 修复端点分报：探索 6/6 = 2 单位 × 3 策略；限定验证 3/3 = 1 单位 × 3 策略；不合并为 9/9。
claims.denominator: 探索 2 单位 × 3 策略 = 6；验证 1 单位 × 3 策略 = 3
claims.allowed_wording: Repair results are reported per endpoint: 6/6 in exploration and 3/3 in the limited validation endpoint.
claims.forbidden_wording: The pooled repair success rate is 9/9.

claims.statement: typer 三单位在 S2 因注册基线未复现而恢复不可评价，维持 E2；不作阴性；C5 精确文本判定维持 false；父 shell 事件链未确认，根因保留未解决。
claims.denominator: 3 个 typer 单位 × 2 块
claims.allowed_wording: Three typer units remained E2 because recovery was not evaluable; this is not negative evidence.
claims.forbidden_wording: The typer effects disappeared; the signals were refuted; the C5 exact-text test now passes.

global_forbidden_claims: certified publication tier or acceptance probability
independent mechanism count equal to unit count
all eight units share the rich read layer
